title: Bellaguna Golf Residences Hibiscus
shortDescription: Hibiscus is a low-rise condominium within Laguna Phuket, overlooking the Laguna Golf Phuket course near Bang Tao Beach.
description: Hibiscus is a low-rise condominium within Laguna Phuket, overlooking the Laguna Golf Phuket course near Bang Tao Beach. It forms part of Bellaguna Golf Residences, which comprises five interconnected finger-shaped low-rise buildings. Layouts range from one to three bedrooms plus two- and three-bedroom penthouses, with four shared pools. Select ground-floor residences have private pools or gardens.
facilities: Four free-form swimming pools with terraces
Select ground-floor units with private pool or garden
Community: Laguna Golf Phuket membership (Laguna Advantage)
